change.summary: Replace dimension-height boss columns with registered structure-shell volume, preserve ordinary event height and repair legacy X/Z-only entry marks.

modifiers.before: Structure minY/maxY saved but visual packets, collision and teleport policy substitute dimension build limits; contains and arenaEntered use X/Z only.
modifiers.after: Canonical shell minY/maxY with existing one-block margin owns side walls, top/bottom collision caps, full player/vehicle box containment and teleport endpoints. Unrelated space above/below is outside. Blood Moon/Resource Rush geometry unchanged.

modifiers.before: EventRegions uses X/Z only for presence, nearby prompts and outsider-mob collection; legacy targetBoss Raid row may add another dimension-height boundary.
modifiers.after: Saved six-coordinate structureBounds adds Y to containment/near/ejection only for structural records. Raid renders exclusively the canonical structure boundary; reward/phase/progression owners unchanged.

modifiers.before: Saved arenaEntered may have been set from the surface above an underground structure.
modifiers.after: Unversioned entry flag is validated once against actual full-box volume; inside becomes arenaVolumeEntry, outside clears only stale arenaEntered. Future real 3D entry persists both; no corrective teleport or participant/reward reset.

rationale.purpose: Keep underground bosses from blocking unrelated chunks/space above or below in Overworld/Nether and other dimensions.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly reports Harbinger and other underground bosses and requests correction then local server startup; this changes the former full-height hosted-boss lock.
rationale.user_requested: Underground structures must not block upper chunks; apply common correction and start server afterward.
rationale.codex_choices: Use actual registered structure volume for all structural arenas, six collision faces, conditional Y-aware event queries and one-time legacy entry migration; preserve wall style.
